downloads.unfinished.name: Unfinished downloads
downloads.unfinished.what: Downloads that stopped before they finished: the part a browser fetched before it was closed or the download failed.
downloads.unfinished.made-by: Your browser (Chrome, Firefox, Opera, Edge and others), while it downloads a file.
downloads.unfinished.if-removed: They go to the Trash. To get the file, download it again.
downloads.unfinished.comes-back: Only if you download the file again.
downloads.safari-resumable.name: Safari downloads you can resume
downloads.safari-resumable.what: Downloads Safari paused or could not finish. Double-clicking one in Finder resumes it.
downloads.safari-resumable.made-by: Safari, while it downloads a file.
downloads.safari-resumable.if-removed: They go to the Trash, and the download cannot be resumed: you start it again from the beginning.
downloads.installers.name: Installers of installed apps
downloads.installers.what: Disk images and packages you used to install apps that are on this Mac now, at this version or newer.
downloads.installers.made-by: You, when you downloaded the app.
downloads.installers.if-removed: They go to the Trash. The app stays installed; to install it again, download it again.
downloads.installers.comes-back: Only if you download it again.
downloads.macos-installers.name: Old macOS installers
downloads.macos-installers.what: Installers of a macOS version this Mac already runs or has passed. Each takes 12 to 15 GB.
downloads.macos-installers.made-by: You or the App Store, when you downloaded macOS.
downloads.macos-installers.if-removed: They go to the Trash. To make a bootable installer later, download it again.
downloads.macos-installers.comes-back: Only if you download it again.
downloads.large-untouched.name: Big downloads you have not opened
downloads.large-untouched.what: Files of 1 GB or more in Downloads that you have not opened or changed for a long time. Only you know whether you still need them.
downloads.large-untouched.if-removed: They go to the Trash. Anything you have only here is lost once you empty the Trash, so look at each one first.
downloads.enabled.label: Downloads and installers
downloads.enabled.description: Finds what piles up in your Downloads folder: unfinished downloads, installers of apps you already have, old macOS installers and big files you have not opened.
downloads.older-than-days.label: Offer downloads untouched for
downloads.older-than-days.description: Unfinished downloads and big files are offered only once they have not changed for this many days, at least 7. Installers are offered as soon as their app is installed.
downloads.title: {name}
downloads.reason.unfinished: This download stopped and has not changed for {days} days.
downloads.reason.placeholder: The empty file a browser keeps beside an unfinished download. It holds nothing.
downloads.reason.safari-resumable: Safari has not continued this download for {days} days.
downloads.reason.installer: {app} {version} is installed, so you no longer need its installer.
downloads.reason.installer-no-version: {app} is installed, so you no longer need its installer.
downloads.reason.macos-installer: This Mac runs macOS {running}, which is as new as this installer or newer.
downloads.reason.large-untouched: {size}, not opened from Finder or changed since {date}. It is your own file: keep it if you are not sure.
downloads.left-out.no-system: Fresher could not ask macOS about your apps or its version, so it keeps this file. Scan again.
downloads.left-out.apps-unread: Fresher could not read every app in your apps folders, so it cannot be sure which app this installer is for.
downloads.left-out.browser-open: The browser that was downloading this is open, so the download may still finish. Quit it, then scan again.
downloads.left-out.recent: It changed within the days set in Settings. A scan after those days offers it.
downloads.left-out.not-older: Fresher cannot tell that the app you have is as new as this installer, so it is kept. Install it, or remove it yourself if you do not need it.
downloads.left-out.newer-macos: This installer is for a newer macOS than this Mac runs, so it is kept.
downloads.left-out.scan-again: Fresher could not look at this in full, so it keeps it. Scan again to check.
downloads.left-out.special: It holds a connection a running program may be using, so it is kept.
downloads.left-out.not-yours: Some of it belongs to the system or another user, or is locked. Removing it needs an administrator.
